video.description:
In this final episode,  Ihor Pavlenko, a quality assurance competence leader at AltexSoft, talks about tracking your DevOps success. 

He explains:
00:45 Why do we need DevOps metrics?
01:54 DevOps performance metrics
• Mean Time to Change
• Deployment Frequency
03:23 DevOps team and software quality control metrics
• Mean Time to Failure
• Mean Time to Detection
• Mean Time to Recovery
• Mean Time between Failures
• Defect Escape Ratio
03:29 Software performance and reliability metrics
• Server Uptime 
• Apdex

Check out more information on DevOps in our articles:
1) DevOps Metrics: Mean Time to Failure, Server Uptime, Mean Time Between Failures, Mean Time to Recovery, and More https://www.

video.title: DevOps Metrics Explained | DORA Metrics Every Engineer Must Know
video.rationale: Covers: topic ✓ (2:09–3:39), CO4.LO3 ✓ (2:09–3:39) [from transcript] · K4 Coding Academy · tier 4 · 7:50 · 338 views · captions
video.description:
Want to measure your DevOps performance like top engineering teams? This video explains the most important DevOps Metrics in a simple and practical way!

In this tutorial, you’ll learn:
✔️ What are DevOps Metrics
✔️ DORA Metrics explained
✔️ Deployment Frequency
✔️ Lead Time for Changes
✔️ Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
✔️ Change Failure Rate
✔️ How to improve DevOps performance

We’ll also cover real-world examples of how companies use these metrics to increase delivery speed, improve reliability, and reduce failures.

🔥 Perfect for:

* DevOps Engineers
* Software Developers
* Engineering Managers
* SRE & Cloud Engineers

💡 By the end of this video, you’ll understand how to track and improve
